name: Private Label - Page - Working With Our Design Team

body.html:
DESIGN SERVICES

Working with our in-house design team.

From logo and label concept through print-ready production. Our designers handle the technical complexity so your brand looks exactly the way you want it on the shelf.

Start Your Label

Start your label here.

Choose your template and fill out the form. Our design team will take it from there.

body.response_message: Thanks for your label selections. Our design team will be in touch shortly.
body.title: Start your Label Here!

body.html:
Don't have a designer? Our team becomes yours.

Most private label clients fall into one of two camps. Either they have brand assets they want to apply to a label template, or they're building their brand from scratch and need help with everything from logo to finished design. We work with both.

Our in-house design team is included with your private label engagement. No separate design retainer, no hourly design fees on top of product costs. You get expert label design built around regulatory requirements and proven shelf appeal.

HOW IT WORKS

Get to market faster with a partner who handles the heavy lifting.

01

BUILD YOUR PRODUCT LINE

Direct access to over 250 doctor-formulated supplements with low minimums and no set-up fees. Choose what fits your audience and your timeline.

02

DESIGN YOUR BRAND

Use your existing logo, customize a new label, or pick from our professional templates. Our in-house design team brings your vision to life.

03

START SELLING FAST

Launch in as little as 3 to 4 weeks after approving your labels. Every product passes rigorous quality assurance before it ships.

HOW IT WORKS

A streamlined process from logo to launch.

1. Brand discovery call

We start with a short conversation about your brand: who your customer is, what feeling you want the label to evoke, what colors and aesthetic you're drawn to, and what your existing brand assets look like (if any).

2. Template selection

Choose from 20+ professionally designed label templates as your starting point. Each template is built to highlight your branding while meeting all FDA labeling requirements. Pick one and we customize from there.

3. Design iteration

Our designers create your custom label, then iterate based on your feedback. Typical revision cycles take 3 to 5 business days. We don't move to print until you're 100% happy with the proof.

4. Print-ready file & label approval

Final files go to print after your written approval. This is when our 3-to-4-week production clock starts. Approve labels Monday, and your private label product ships in less than a month.

WHAT YOU GET

A complete brand identity, not just a label.

Most private label manufacturers stop at putting your logo on a generic label template. We go further. If you don't have a logo yet, we'll design one. If your brand needs typography and color guidance, we provide it. If you want to align labels across multiple SKUs into a cohesive product line, that's where we shine. Our designers think about your entire shelf presence, not just a single bottle.

WHAT WE NEED FROM YOU

To get started, gather these items.

✓

Your business name (and DBA if different)

✓

Your logo, if you have one (vector format preferred but not required)

✓

Brand color preferences or a sample of any existing brand collateral

✓

The list of products you want to private label

✓

Any required regulatory information specific to your distribution channel

✓

Examples of supplement labels you like (competitor or otherwise) as design inspiration

ALREADY HAVE A DESIGNER

You can also supply your own artwork.
If you have an in-house designer or an agency partner, we can work with their output directly. You'll need to follow our file format and color requirements to avoid rework delays.

Ready to start designing your label? Most clients have a print-ready label within 2 weeks.

Start Your Label

50+ YEARS OF SUPPLEMENT MANUFACTURING

Developed by us. Made for you.

With over 50 years in the health supplement industry, we are one of the most trusted dietary supplement manufacturers. Every private label supplement we produce is doctor-formulated using thoroughly researched ingredients, then scientifically reviewed for efficacy and quality before it ever enters production in our U.S. facilities.

FoodScience is an FDA-registered food facility, GMP certified to SQF food safety standards, and certified to NSF GMP 455-2.

When you partner with us, our expert team is with you every step of the way. Help your customers find what they want from a source they trust. You.

Frequently asked questions

None

How long does label design typically take? +
Most clients finalize designs in 2-4 weeks from kickoff. Faster is possible if your brand identity is already locked. Slower happens when there are many decision-makers who need to review or when the brand direction is still being figured out.
Who do I work with directly? +
You're assigned a designer who is your primary contact throughout the engagement. Your account manager joins for kickoff and major checkpoints. The design team has been working together for years, so you benefit from accumulated knowledge of supplement label conventions and FDA-compliant layouts.
Can I see other brands you have designed for? +
Yes. We share a portfolio of past designs during your consultation. Some brands have asked us to keep their work confidential, so the public portfolio represents a subset of what we've produced. Ask your account manager and they can speak to specific brand examples relevant to your category.
What formats do you provide the final files in? +
Print-ready PDF for production (CMYK, correct bleed and trim), high-resolution PNG for digital use, and source files in Adobe Illustrator. You can use the digital assets for your website, Amazon listing, and marketing materials.
What happens after the first run? Can I refresh the design? +
Yes. Many clients refresh labels after their first run based on customer feedback or repositioning. We retain your files and can iterate them or do a full redesign whenever you want. Refresh work is included for active clients.
